He initially asked Claude to solve the issue, but the model repeatedly declared success without verifying the result because it lacked an automated reproduction. Abramov guided Claude to establish a measurable proxy repro using Playwright MCP, verified that commenting out the trigger produced a passing result, and instructed the agent to methodically delete code while keeping the failure active.
